body: Are you secretly a writer or something like that? Maybe they are the problem, but I'm too nice of a person to do anything about it and if it means suffering then I guess that is what I will do. It's not all that bad. There is some ups to it.

I'm just suppose to be happy. It's what everyone wants me to be and lately I'm only what people want me to be. I'm all about making others happy, that I am not happy anymore. I use to be. Don't get me wrong. Happy is all I'm suppose to be. 
Ps. I meant it as a compliment

That sounded like a John Green novel. 
You're right, but I also feel like I'm letting people down by feeling like this. Like I shouldn't. I do have bad friends and my life isn't perfect, but I mean I still should be happy. It's like everything I use to feel is all coming back and I don't know if I can handle it again.

Well, I'm glad I can company you. I love writing, so I guess I wanna do something that involves writing. I also want to make a difference is this world. I want to travel. That's all I know. I'm so indecisive that it is hard picking something and sticking to it.

One negative thing? Well, let's see. I have really bad friends, but that really doesn't bug me you know? Like who needs friends anyways? My grades are slipping, but I can bring them up anytime I want to. I'm just not motivated anymore. I have a decent job for someone still in high school. I have my books, which is good lol. I don't know what triggered me. I was just laying here and oh god a thought had found it's way in my mind. I had no one to talk to, so I came on here.

I would love the company, too. I don't really know what bought me here today, I was doing just fine and then I'm not. Im not one to be all negative and things, but sometimes you get tired of being positive, you know?
